newsitem.title: USA: Washington Water files $150 mln shelf pref.
newsitem.headline: Washington Water files $150 mln shelf pref.

text.p: Washington Water Power Co said Tuesday a business trust that it formed filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission for the public offering of up to $150 million in preferred securities.

Net proceeds from the sale of the securities will be invested in subordinated debt securities of Washington Water, which it will use to finance the construction, improvement and maintainance of its facilities, retire or exchange certain outstanding securities and for general corporate purposes.
The offering will be made through Merrill Lynch & Co. The business trust is called Washington Water Power Capital I.
